text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Sirius.
The brightest first-magnitude star.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Today, in this very moment... I'll burn my brilliance as a first-magnitude star into the eyes of all who watch.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Don't look away just 'cause
you're terrified of my brilliance, got it, pup?
